name: Foodie
subtitle: Grocery expiry tracker for SideStore
description: Foodie tracks food and grocery expiry with on-device barcode scan, best-before OCR, multi-source product lookup, and offline produce recognition. IPAs are packaged for SideStore / AltStore.

app.name: Foodie
app.subtitle: Food & grocery expiry tracker
app.localizedDescription: Scan barcodes, read best-before dates on-device, recognize produce from photos using a bundled offline catalog, and sync via the Foodie Worker API. Install with SideStore or AltStore.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Foodie scans barcodes, best-before dates, and produce photos.
